text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...If I just do things like I always do,
everything should be fine, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was on the way back from an outing that she ended up participating in a mini-live on short notice.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Believe-chan!
Wait, what's wrong? Is something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dantsu-san...
Actually, we're having a mini-live concert
for the shopping district after this, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best for the girl
who couldn't make it because she was sick!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
For lending me a hand.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"No. I was the one who brought it up on my own.
Still... that really is a massive crowd of spectators."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...I'm getting kind of nervous.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: There seem to be especially many today—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
“Still, all we have to do is give our best performance.
...Let's do our best.”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Believe-chan is always so dignified and amazing... Yeah... I have to do my best too!"

text_block_list.name: Sloped-Shouldered Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I stood before such a large crowd.
...My hands are starting to shake.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Straight Bangs
text_block_list.text:
Deep breath, deep breath...
Inhale... exhale... inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Guess I'll do something too!
Write 'Umamusume' three times on my palm... and swallow it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She seems to have caught the nervous energy of the crowd. Just as I think about giving her a push forward—I suddenly remember an outing with her.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "In that case, I'll give you a piggyback ride!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, do you want to come with me?
To play soccer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember how kind she is, always reading the room.
What I need to do for her right now is—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wh-Why are you dancing
the Umapyoi, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
Trainer has become strangeâ

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ……*snicker*

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Ahahaha!
choice_data_list: Alright, that's the wonderful smile I always see.
Alright, you've got your usual great smile.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ! Huh... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Yes!
I'll be on my way just like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the mini-live kicked off amidst roaring cheers—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Your favorite horse!!
Your favorite horse!!
MY favorite horse!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, amid thunderous cheers, the curtain fell.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The reactions to the concert on social media are looking great too.
I'm so glad it went well...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It's all thanks to your 'Umapyoi', Trainer!♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She offers her thanks, but she doesn't seem to realize that those actions originated from herself.
choice_data_list: No, I was just imitating you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw her self-sacrificing kindness for the sake of a young girl.
That's why I wanted to do something for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw his kindness in voluntarily stepping forward for the boy's sake.
That's why dancing 'Umapyoi Densetsu' in front of everyone was nothing to me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Learned... from me—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Still... to begin with,
it's all because Trainer-san is so kind.”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of me,
imitating me, they danced—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Something so wonderful...
I wouldn't do it for anyone but you.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! Oh, right. Can you guess what I'm thinking about right now?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. With how you are right now, Trainer,
maybe you really can do it!
choice_data_list: You wanna see my Umapyoi again, huh?
Do you... want to see my Umapyoi again?
Tomorrow's training is gonna be tough, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. With how you are right now, Trainer,
maybe you really can do it!
choice_data_list: You wanna see my Umapyoi again, huh?
Do you... want to see my Umapyoi again?
Tomorrow's training is gonna be tough, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Th-That's...
To be honest, I'm really curious...!
Is it okay if I take it that way?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm half joking. But still—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm... half serious, you know.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh! Really!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! Jeez, Trainer.
B-But... even if it's true, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not quite there yet~
The correct answer is...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That's a secret!
Try to guess it yourself someday.
